title: Transition-compatible finite Hom components
statement: Fix the same data as lem-sf-integral-hom-tower-components. With H the derived internal-Hom functor in the first variable, there exist isomorphisms θ_n : H(T(P)_n) ≅ T(P′)_n such that H(r_n) ≫ θ_n.hom = θ_(n+1).hom ≫ r′_n for every n.

proof.text: Choose A,I,Q and the two separate tower isomorphisms. They express the source as localized Hom(A,I tensor Q_n) and the target as localized Hom(A,I) tensor Q_n, with the same coefficient transitions.

source.place: paragraph 1: finite-free coefficient construction, applied naturally to the quotient tower

proof.text: Whisker the signed tensor-Hom natural transformation by Q and localization. For each n its chain map is degreewise invertible by the two-term free component theorem. A complex map with invertible components is invertible; localization preserves isomorphisms, and a natural transformation with invertible components is invertible.

proof.text: Compose the first tower model isomorphism, the inverse of the localized signed comparison and the inverse of the second model isomorphism. The naturality of this composite isomorphism at the consecutive quotient map is precisely the asserted square.

theorem reductionTower_components_transition
    (K : completedIntegralDerivedCategory l E Y D hl)
    (P G P' G' : CochainComplex (completedIntegralModuleSheaves l E Y D hl) ℤ)
    (q : P ⟶ G) (q' : P' ⟶ G')
    (hq : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q)
    (hq' : CochainComplex.IsKFlatResolutionIndependentCoefficients
      (J := AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology Y)
      (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl) q')
    (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj G' ≅
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl)).obj
        (op K, DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)) :
    let H := (Functor.curry.obj
      (hom.{t, u} Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheaf l E Y D hl))).obj (op K)
    ∃ θ : ∀ n : ℕ, H.obj ((integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P).obj (op n)) ≅
        (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P').obj (op n),
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        H.map ((integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P).map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op) ≫
            (θ n).hom =
          (θ (n + 1)).hom ≫
            (integralReductionTower l E Y D hl P').map (homOfLE n.le_succ).op
